items.item_text: Skill in demonstrating work experience with a database computer program

In this highly visible Administrative Assistant role, you will provide both administrative and patient care support while serving as an important connection point throughout the patient experience. As a valued member of the Neurology Clinic team, you will help coordinate seamless patient flow from registration through discharge, ensuring every visit is efficient, compassionate, and patient focused. Your ability to multitask, communicate effectively, and collaborate with clinical staff will directly contribute to exceptional patient satisfaction and smooth day-to-day clinic operations.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast paced healthcare environment, thrives on teamwork, and is passionate about creating a welcoming and supportive experience for every patient.
Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with physicians and staff in a high volume setting.
Skill in using a PC with associated programs including Word, Excel, and Email
Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize assignments
Knowledge of major medical insurance plans and types of coverage provided
Skill in efficiently and accurately facilitating the appointment making process, including transportation arrangements and maintain sub-specialty physician schedules
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to coordinate multiple appointments with staff from many clinical services at the UCLA Medical Center
